convert_unclip_txt2img_to_image_variatio: run the script to convert a pretrained UnCLIP text-to-image pipeline to an image variation pipeline and save it
create_unclip_image_variation_pipeline: create an UnCLIPImageVariationPipeline by reusing components from a pretrained UnCLIPPipeline with a CLIP image encoder
load_pretrained_unclip_pipeline: load a pretrained UnCLIPPipeline model such as kakaobrain/karlo-v1-alpha using from_pretrained
save_unclip_pipeline: save a converted UnCLIPImageVariationPipeline to a specified output directory using save_pretrained
add_clip_image_encoder: add a CLIPVisionModelWithProjection image encoder and CLIPImageProcessor to an UnCLIP pipeline for image variation
